mapper.select: SELECT grade_code, grade_name, minimum_points, sort_order, use_yn FROM member_grades ORDER BY sort_order, grade_code

SELECT role_list.member_role, permission.permission_code, permission.permission_name, permission.permission_description, COALESCE(role_permission.allowed_yn, 'N') AS allowed_yn FROM ( SELECT 'USER' AS member_role UNION ALL SELECT 'ADMIN' UNION ALL SELECT 'SUPER_ADMIN' ) role_list CROSS JOIN permissions permission LEFT JOIN role_permissions role_permission ON role_permission.member_role = role_list.member_role AND role_permission.permission_code = permission.permission_code ORDER BY FIELD(role_list.member_role, 'USER', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'), permission.permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_permissions (member_role, permission_code, allowed_yn) VALUES (#{memberRole}, #{permissionCode}, #{allowedYn}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE allowed_yn = VALUES(allowed_yn), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
INSERT INTO visitor_events (visitor_key, member_id, visited_path) VALUES (#{visitorKey}, #{memberId}, #{visitedPath})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) FROM visitor_events WHERE visited_at >= CURRENT_DATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) FROM visitor_events WHERE visited_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), '%Y-%m-01')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS page_views FROM visitor_events WHERE visited_at >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 13 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY period

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m') AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS page_views FROM visitor_events WHERE visited_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 11 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY period

SELECT visit.visitor_key, visit.member_id, member.login_id, member.member_name, visit.visited_path, visit.visited_at FROM visitor_events visit LEFT JOIN members member ON member.member_id = visit.member_id ORDER BY visit.visited_at DESC, visit.visitor_event_id DESC LIMIT 50
